title: Reconcile sql_migration_registry with live migration sources and open governed registration for the unregistered backlog
summary: Registry/live reconciliation: restamp 15 intentionally revised source hashes, retire 4 deliberately removed files, register 89 unregistered migration files (hashes precomputed); plus two recipe/sequence decisions for the governor.
origin: Worker evidence gathering under ordered-release preparation; measurement via GPTBridge.CodexPipeline --migration-status (migration-executor-status/v1) against live gptbridge DB; no execution authority requested

problem.summary: sql_migration_registry diverges from shared-layer/migrations: 15 registered rows carry source hashes of pre-repair files, 4 rows name files deliberately deleted at lane retirement, and 89 on-disk migration files have no registry row. sql_migration_receipt_registry holds 0 receipts and sql_schema_drift_evidence is stale UNVERIFIED/FAIL_CLOSED. The governed executor exists (MigrationExecutor.cs, scratch-verified) but cannot legally apply anything until the registry is reconciled.
